component.name: KeyDeck
component.summary: Phone macro pad host for the desktop

description.p: KeyDeck turns a phone into a programmable macro pad. This is the desktop host: it shows the pairing QR code, lets you program every key and injects the keystrokes. Pair over WiFi or Bluetooth.
Keystroke injection needs xdotool (X11) or ydotool (Wayland) installed on the system. KeyDeck runs them, and the commands you program, on the host, outside the sandbox.
